EnfeeblePlayer.name: Enfeeble
EnfeeblePlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

FirestormPlayer.name: Firestorm
FirestormPlayer.description: Rains flaming bolts over the targeted area. Ignites on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Firestorm, causing one bolt to be improved for each Ignite Consumed.

SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.description: Summons Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can be Commanded to cast icy explosions.
SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Frost Mage Minion

MagneticSalvoPlayer.description: Aims skyward and fires energy missiles at lingering arrows or bolts created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
MagneticSalvoPlayer.name: Magnetic Salvo

MetaCastOnBlockPlayer.name: Cast on Block
MetaCastOnBlockPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

SupportUpheavalPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and attack speed.
SupportUpheavalPlayer.name: Upheaval

MantraOfDestructionPlayer.description:
Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants
Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
MantraOfDestructionPlayer.name: Mantra of Destruction

PurityOfIcePlayer.name: Purity of Ice
PurityOfIcePlayer.description: Emits an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of Allies in your Presence. The Aura does not affect you.

SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.
SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.name: Fire Infusion

PoisonBurstArrowPlayer.description: Fires a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.
PoisonBurstArrowPlayer.name: Poisonburst Arrow

SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.
SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.name: Heavy Swing

SupportInspirationPlayer.description: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportInspirationPlayer.name: Inspiration

BerserkPlayer.name: Berserk
BerserkPlayer.description: While active, strengthens your Rage and grants you Life Leech based on your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while Raging.

SnipersMarkPlayer.name: Sniper's Mark
SnipersMarkPlayer.description: Marks a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives consumes the Mark to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.

SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.description: Summons long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.
SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.name: Skeletal Sniper Minion

PlasmaBlastAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain.
PlasmaBlastAmmoPlayer.name: Load Plasma Blast

SupportDazedBreakPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.
SupportDazedBreakPlayer.name: Break Posture

SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.
SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.name: Drain Ailments

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.name: Deadly Poison

SupportImpetusPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
SupportImpetusPlayer.name: Impetus

FrostWallPlayer.name: Frost Wall
FrostWallPlayer.description: Creates a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies.

ConductivityPlayer.name: Conductivity
ConductivityPlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Lightning Resistance.

DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.description: Fires a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.
DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.name: Vile Effusion

SummonInfernalHoundPlayer.description: Summons a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it. The Hound takes a portion of damage from Hits for you.
SummonInfernalHoundPlayer.name: Summon Infernal Hound

SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.name: Lightning Mastery

DetonatingArrowPlayer.description: Channel to build up power before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum charge, the arrow will detonate at the end of its flight, causing an explosion in an area around it.
DetonatingArrowPlayer.name: Detonating Arrow

StormcallerArrowPlayer.description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies with a high chance to Shock.
StormcallerArrowPlayer.name: Stormcaller Arrow

SupportCrescendoPlayer.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.
SupportCrescendoPlayer.name: Crescendo

MetaCastOnMeleeKillPlayer.name: Cast on Melee Kill
MetaCastOnMeleeKillPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.name: Elemental Invocation
MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.description: While active, this Invocation gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

SorceryWardPlayer.description: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
SorceryWardPlayer.name: Sorcery Ward

MeleeBowPlayer.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.
MeleeBowPlayer.name: Bow Shot

ReapPlayer.name: Reap
ReapPlayer.description: Conjures a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness.

GlacialCascadePlayer.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
GlacialCascadePlayer.name: Glacial Cascade

CometPlayer.name: Comet
CometPlayer.description: Calls down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.
SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.name: Cold Penetration

VolatileDeadPlayer.name: Volatile Dead
VolatileDeadPlayer.description: Consumes a Corpse to create a fireball that seeks out enemies and explodes.

BoneshatterPlayer.description: Attacks enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
BoneshatterPlayer.name: Boneshatter

KillingPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an unarmed Attack, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted. This skill always Strikes with your bare fist, even if you have a Quarterstaff equipped.
KillingPalmPlayer.name: Killing Palm

SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage.
SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.name: Feeding Frenzy

RapidShotPlayer.description: Fires heavily modified bolts that cause Heat to build up on your crossbow. Using this skill causes an initial buildup of Heat before unleashing a stream of flaming bolts that gain Fire Damage based on your Heat. Heat also grants bonus damage to Grenades you fire, but dissipates rapidly when not building up. Can fire a large number of bolts before needing to reload.
RapidShotPlayer.name: Rapid Shot

PurityOfLightningPlayer.name: Purity of Lightning
PurityOfLightningPlayer.description: Emits an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of Allies in your Presence. The Aura does not affect you.

SigilOfPowerPlayer.name: Sigil of Power
SigilOfPowerPlayer.description: Places a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

FlammabilityPlayer.name: Flammability
FlammabilityPlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Fire Resistance.

AlchemistsBoonPlayer.name: Alchemist's Boon
AlchemistsBoonPlayer.description: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.

ChargeInfusionPlayer.name: Charge Infusion
ChargeInfusionPlayer.description: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.

SupportBloodFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create stationary objects. Objects created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood, creating an Aura which grants Life regeneration.
SupportBloodFountainPlayer.name: Font of Blood

ShardScavengerPlayer.description: While active, Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour on an enemy reloads your Crossbow. This can only occur once every few seconds.
ShardScavengerPlayer.name: Shard Scavenger

FrostBombPlayer.name: Frost Bomb
FrostBombPlayer.description: Creates a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Cold Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it explodes, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies.

HandOfChayulaPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an unarmed Attack, applying socketed Curses and Marks with reduced effect. This skill always Strikes with your bare fist, even if you have a Quarterstaff equipped.
HandOfChayulaPlayer.name: Hand of Chayula

SupportPrecisionPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.
SupportPrecisionPlayer.name: Precision

SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.
SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.name: Cold Infusion

ShockchainArrowPlayer.description: Fires a Lightning-infused arrow that homes in on Shocked enemies. Hitting a Shocked enemy will Consume the Shock to charge the arrow, causing it to release a damaging shockwave and split beams towards up to two nearby targets, prioritising ones which are Shocked. If the beam hits a Shocked target, it will release another damaging shockwave and can continue to Chain.
ShockchainArrowPlayer.name: Shockchain Arrow

VoltaicMarkPlayer.name: Voltaic Mark
VoltaicMarkPlayer.description: Marks a target, making them more susceptible to being Shocked. When the Marked target dies, a Lightning nova erupts from their corpse. This nova does not use your Weapon Damage, and instead uses its own base Attack Damage.

MetaCastOnIgnitePlayer.name: Cast on Ignite
MetaCastOnIgnitePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Ignite enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

SupportAutoReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
SupportAutoReloadPlayer.name: Auto Reload

SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.
SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.name: Ritualistic Curse

SupportAmbushPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.
SupportAmbushPlayer.name: Ambush

MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.name: Reaper's Invocation
MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.description: While active, this Invocation gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

SupportChaoticAssassinationPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.
SupportChaoticAssassinationPlayer.name: Intense Agony

SupportWeaponElementalDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks that use a weapon, causing them to deal more weapon Elemental damage.
SupportWeaponElementalDamagePlayer.name: Primal Armament

SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.description: Summons hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies.
SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.name: Skeletal Brute Minion

HeraldOfThunderPlayer.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with Attack damage, will cause subsequent Attack hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
HeraldOfThunderPlayer.name: Herald of Thunder

SnipePlayer.description: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing the moment you fully charge causes the arrow to explode on impact for a guaranteed Critical Hit.
SnipePlayer.name: Snipe

HailstormRoundsPlayer.description: Fires all loaded bolts into the sky, causing them to rain down over the target area.
HailstormRoundsPlayer.name: Hailstorm Rounds

SupportExpansePlayer.description: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExpansePlayer.name: Expanse

SupportForkPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.
SupportForkPlayer.name: Fork

SupportColdMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportColdMasteryPlayer.name: Cold Mastery

SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.description: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.
SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.name: Corpse Conservation

HeraldOfPlaguePlayer.name: Herald of Plague
HeraldOfPlaguePlayer.description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.

SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.
SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.name: Rising Tempest

IceNovaPlayer.name: Ice Nova
IceNovaPlayer.description: A nova of ice expands from you, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you, and cause more Freeze buildup.

ShockburstRoundsPlayer.description: Rapidly fires charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
ShockburstRoundsPlayer.name: Shockburst Rounds

SupportAftershockChancePlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.
SupportAftershockChancePlayer.name: Aftershock

SupportFasterProjectilesPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.
SupportFasterProjectilesPlayer.name: Acceleration

SupportMultiplePoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.
SupportMultiplePoisonPlayer.name: Comorbidity

SupportSpellCascadePlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location, causing those Spells to also target additional areas on either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis. Cannot support Channelling skills or Remote skills.
SupportSpellCascadePlayer.name: Spell Cascade

ClusterGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a nova of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.
ClusterGrenadePlayer.name: Cluster Grenade

FrostboltPlayer.name: Frostbolt
FrostboltPlayer.description: Fires a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that leaves a wake of Chilled Ground, deals Cold damage and explodes on colliding with terrain.

StaffUnleashNextSpellPlayer.name: Unleash
StaffUnleashNextSpellPlayer.description: Infuses your staff arcane energy for a short duration, Empowering the next spell you cast to reoccur.

SupportStompingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.
SupportStompingGroundPlayer.name: Stomping Ground

VaultingImpactPlayer.description: Leaps forward and Slams the ground, sending out a Stunning shockwave that is especially potent against Dazed enemies.
VaultingImpactPlayer.name: Vaulting Impact

SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.name: Corrupting Cry

DetonateDeadPlayer.name: Detonate Dead
DetonateDeadPlayer.description: Causes a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

EarthshatterPlayer.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.
EarthshatterPlayer.name: Earthshatter

ElectrocutingArrowPlayer.description: Leap forward into the air and fire downward. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
ElectrocutingArrowPlayer.name: Electrocuting Arrow

GlacialBoltAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.
GlacialBoltAmmoPlayer.name: Load Glacial Bolt

ManaDrainPlayer.name: Mana Drain
ManaDrainPlayer.description: Siphons power from an enemy, briefly Hindering them and Leeching Mana.

PlagueBearerNovaPlayer.description: Release all Poison stored by Plague Bearer, dealing an equal amount of Physical Damage to enemies around you.
PlagueBearerNovaPlayer.name: Plague Nova

ManaTempestPlayer.name: Mana Tempest
ManaTempestPlayer.description: Creates a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and each Spell you cast causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.

SupportExecratePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExecratePlayer.name: Execrate

IncendiaryShotAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target.
IncendiaryShotAmmoPlayer.name: Load Incendiary Shot

SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source.
SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.name: Chaotic Freeze

ArmourPiercingBoltsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
ArmourPiercingBoltsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Armour Piercing Rounds

PlagueBearerPlayer.name: Plague Bearer
PlagueBearerPlayer.description: Stores all Poison Damage you deal. Using the Plague Nova skill unleashes the stored Poison.

SupportBiddingPlayer.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal significantly more damage with their Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayer.name: Bidding

StaggeringPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Unarmed Attack. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff and Unarmed Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Enemies which are Primed for Stun will instantly be Heavily Stunned. This skill always Strikes with your bare fist, even if you have a Quarterstaff equipped.
StaggeringPalmPlayer.name: Staggering Palm

ExsanguinatePlayer.name: Exsanguinate
ExsanguinatePlayer.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with a Debuff that deals Physical damage over time.

SupportFireMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportFireMasteryPlayer.name: Fire Mastery

GhostDancePlayer.name: Ghost Dance
GhostDancePlayer.description: Periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.

DoomBlastPlayer.description: Deals Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.
DoomBlastPlayer.name: Doom Blast

SupportManaOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.
SupportManaOnCullPlayer.name: Soul Drain

AncestralWarriorTotemPlayer.description: Raises a Totem that uses socketed Mace Skills. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
AncestralWarriorTotemPlayer.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem

SupportStripAwayPlayer.description: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.
SupportStripAwayPlayer.name: Strip Away

SeismicCryPlayer.name: Seismic Cry
SeismicCryPlayer.description: Performs a damaging warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies. If a Heavy Stunned enemy is hit, your next Slam is Empowered to perform an additional Aftershock. If not, this skill's cooldown is reset. Only counts Heavily Stunned enemies for purposes of counting Power Gained.

RaiseZombiePlayer.description: Consumes a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered.
RaiseZombiePlayer.name: Raise Zombie

SupportRupturePlayer.description: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.
SupportRupturePlayer.name: Rupture

ExplosiveShotAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
ExplosiveShotAmmoPlayer.name: Load Explosive Shot

FragmentationRoundsPlayer.description: Fires Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode.
FragmentationRoundsPlayer.name: Fragmentation Rounds

IncendiaryShotPlayer.description: Fires flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target.
IncendiaryShotPlayer.name: Incendiary Shot

MagmaBarrierPlayer.name: Magma Barrier
MagmaBarrierPlayer.description: When you raise your Shield it is infused with magma for a short time. Blocking during this time will spray magma at the attacker and grant you an Endurance Charge.

SupportVitalityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportVitalityPlayer.name: Vitality

ExplosiveShotPlayer.description: Fires a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
ExplosiveShotPlayer.name: Explosive Shot

HeraldOfIcePlayer.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with an Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
HeraldOfIcePlayer.name: Herald of Ice

GalvanicShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fires charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload.
GalvanicShardsPlayer.name: Galvanic Shards

SacrificePlayer.name: Sacrifice
SacrificePlayer.description: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.

ShatteringConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a bottle that explodes, dealing unarmed Cold attack damage in an area and inflicting Cold Exposure.
ShatteringConcoctionPlayer.name: Shattering Concoction

StaffConsecratePlayer.name: Consecrate
StaffConsecratePlayer.description: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground around you.

SparkPlayer.name: Spark
SparkPlayer.description: Launches a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire.

FallingThunderPlayer.description: Infuses your Quarterstaff with electrical energies, then Slams the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
FallingThunderPlayer.name: Falling Thunder

SupportHinderPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies.
SupportHinderPlayer.name: Hinder

MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.name: Cast on Dodge
MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

GalvanicShardsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
GalvanicShardsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Galvanic Shards

SupportBlindPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.
SupportBlindPlayer.name: Blind

SupportBurningRunesPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.
SupportBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription

SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.name: Ammo Conservation

SupportFreshClipPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.
SupportFreshClipPlayer.name: Fresh Clip

WitheringPresencePlayer.name: Withering Presence
WitheringPresencePlayer.description: While active, periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

PermafrostBoltsPlayer.description: Fires icy bolts that  fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies.
PermafrostBoltsPlayer.name: Permafrost Bolts

SupportColdExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Cold Exposure when it Critically Hits an enemy.
SupportColdExposurePlayer.name: Cold Exposure

ShockNovaPlayer.name: Shock Nova
ShockNovaPlayer.description: Unleashes a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies.

SupportStormfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, prolonging Shocks they inflict on Ignited enemies.
SupportStormfirePlayer.name: Stormfire

ShockwaveTotemPlayer.description: Raises a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it.
ShockwaveTotemPlayer.name: Shockwave Totem

BonestormPlayer.name: Bonestorm
BonestormPlayer.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel lodges in enemies hit, each causing the next Attack against that enemy to deal additional damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.

SiegeCascadePlayer.description: Aims skyward and fires an enemy-seeking payload which drops a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
SiegeCascadePlayer.name: Siege Cascade

SupportGlacierPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.
SupportGlacierPlayer.name: Glacier

SupportArmourBreakPlayer.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportArmourBreakPlayer.name: Splinter

MetaCastOnFreezePlayer.name: Cast on Freeze
MetaCastOnFreezePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

SpiralVolleyPlayer.description: Loads your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fires them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.
SpiralVolleyPlayer.name: Spiral Volley

TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.description: Creates Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based off a percentage of your Maximum Mana.
TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription

BarragePlayer.description: Ready a volley of arrows, Empowering your next Bow Attack to repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
BarragePlayer.name: Barrage

DefianceBannerReservationPlayer.name: Defiance Banner
DefianceBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, killing enemies with Attacks or standing near a Unique enemy generates Valour. Using this Skill consumes its Valour to place an inspiring Banner with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed while the Banner lasts. The Banner cannot gain Valour while placed, and you cannot place a Banner while you already have a Banner placed.

TCAncestralLeagueKaruiHulk.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.
TCAncestralLeagueKaruiHulk.name: Shield Charge

DestructiveLinkSkeletonBombadierMinion.name: Explosive Demise
DestructiveLinkSkeletonBombadierMinion.description: Detonates an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy damage to nearby enemies.

GalvanicFieldPlayer.name: Galvanic Field
GalvanicFieldPlayer.description: Grants a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.

AttritionPlayer.name: Attrition
AttritionPlayer.description: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.

TemporalRiftPlayer.description: Passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time.
TemporalRiftPlayer.name: Temporal Rift

WarBannerReservationPlayer.name: War Banner
WarBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, killing enemies with Attacks or standing near a Unique enemy generates Valour. Using this Skill consumes its Valour to place an inspiring Banner with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage and Accuracy while the Banner lasts. The Banner cannot gain Valour while placed, and you cannot place a Banner while you already have a Banner placed.

SupportHexBloomPlayer.description: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.
SupportHexBloomPlayer.name: Hex Bloom

SupportWildfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.
SupportWildfirePlayer.name: Wildfire

SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.description: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.
SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.name: Astral Projection

ArchmagePlayer.name: Archmage
ArchmagePlayer.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.

FreezingMarkPlayer.name: Freezing Mark
FreezingMarkPlayer.description: Marks a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target dies, a Cold nova erupts from their corpse. This nova does not use your Weapon Damage, and instead uses its own base Attack Damage.

EmergencyReloadPlayer.description: Instantly reloads your active Crossbow Ammunition and Empowers the loaded bolts to deal more damage.
EmergencyReloadPlayer.name: Emergency Reload

SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.
SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.name: Minion Instability

ExplosiveConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a bottle that explodes, dealing unarmed Fire attack damage in an area and inflicting Fire Exposure.
ExplosiveConcoctionPlayer.name: Explosive Concoction

IceShotPlayer.description: Fires an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
IceShotPlayer.name: Ice Shot

HammerOfTheGodsPlayer.description: Entreats the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
HammerOfTheGodsPlayer.name: Hammer of the Gods

SupportMobilityPlayer.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.
SupportMobilityPlayer.name: Mobility

TornadoShotPlayer.description: Fires a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a nova of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.
TornadoShotPlayer.name: Tornado Shot

FireBombSkeletonMinion.description: Attacks with a bouncing bomb that explodes on hit.
FireBombSkeletonMinion.name: Fire Bomb

FlashGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires. This explosion can Blind both Allies and Enemies.
FlashGrenadePlayer.name: Flash Grenade

RollingSlamPlayer.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam. Holding down the skill input allows you to change direction as you move.
RollingSlamPlayer.name: Rolling Slam

BoneCagePlayer.name: Bone Cage
BoneCagePlayer.description: Raises a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies.

SupportHeftPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.
SupportHeftPlayer.name: Heft

RipwireBallistaPlayer.description: Deploys a Ballista Totem that fires Pinning bolts which Maim Enemies.
RipwireBallistaPlayer.name: Ripwire Ballista

GasArrowPlayer.description: Fires a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
GasArrowPlayer.name: Gas Arrow

StormblastBoltsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
StormblastBoltsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Stormblast Bolts

SupportIncreasedAreaOfEffectPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.
SupportIncreasedAreaOfEffectPlayer.name: Magnified Effect

MetaCastOnMeleeStunPlayer.name: Cast on Melee Stun
MetaCastOnMeleeStunPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

SupportLockdownPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.
SupportLockdownPlayer.name: Lockdown

MoltenBlastPlayer.description: Gouges molten rock from the ground and flings it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
MoltenBlastPlayer.name: Molten Blast

OilGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
OilGrenadePlayer.name: Oil Grenade

SoulOfferingPlayer.name: Soul Offering
SoulOfferingPlayer.description:
Impales a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions.

The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

SupportFasterAttackPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
SupportFasterAttackPlayer.name: Martial Tempo

InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.description: The enemy's Corpse violently explodes, dealing Fire damage in an area around it.
InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.name: Combust

RagingSpiritsPlayer.description: While active, your Fire Spells will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
RagingSpiritsPlayer.name: Raging Spirits

MeditatePlayer.description: Channels to Recharge Energy Shield. Can overcharge your Energy Shield up to double its normal maximum. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is double its normal maximum. This skill cannot be used if your Energy Shield is already double its normal maximum or you have no maximum Energy Shield.
MeditatePlayer.name: Meditate

SupportConcentratedEffectPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.
SupportConcentratedEffectPlayer.name: Concentrated Effect

HypothermiaPlayer.name: Hypothermia
HypothermiaPlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Cold Resistance.

FireballPlayer.name: Fireball
FireballPlayer.description: Launches a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact, creating a nova of smaller firebolts.

StormWavePlayer.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long wave ahead of you.
StormWavePlayer.name: Storm Wave

PowerSiphonPlayer.name: Power Siphon
PowerSiphonPlayer.description: Attempts to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.

LifeRemnantsPlayer.description: Drinks the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
LifeRemnantsPlayer.name: Life Remnants

StampedePlayer.description: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them.
StampedePlayer.name: Stampede

SupportLongFusePlayer.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, causing those Grenades to have much higher duration and damage.
SupportLongFusePlayer.name: Long Fuse

ChargedStaffPlayer.description: Consume all Power Charges to infuse your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
ChargedStaffPlayer.name: Charged Staff

TemporalChainsPlayer.name: Temporal Chains
TemporalChainsPlayer.description: Curses all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

FistOfWarSupportPlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
FistOfWarSupportPlayer.name: Fist of War

SupportHerbalismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.
SupportHerbalismPlayer.name: Herbalism

SupportCoursingCurrentPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.
SupportCoursingCurrentPlayer.name: Coursing Current

PurityOfFirePlayer.name: Purity of Fire
PurityOfFirePlayer.description: Emits an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of Allies in your Presence. The Aura does not affect you.

EssenceDrainPlayer.name: Essence Drain
EssenceDrainPlayer.description: Fires a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

RuthlessSupportPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.
RuthlessSupportPlayer.name: Ruthless

ArmourBreakerPlayer.description: Attack with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.
ArmourBreakerPlayer.name: Armour Breaker

SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.
SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.name: Exploit Weakness

MetaCastOnShockPlayer.name: Cast on Shock
MetaCastOnShockPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Shock enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

GatheringStormPlayer.description: Flips backward and Channels to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing dashes towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with perfect timing performs a Lightning-infused dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through and leaves a trail of Shocked Ground in your wake.
GatheringStormPlayer.name: Gathering Storm

ToxicGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
ToxicGrenadePlayer.name: Gas Grenade

SupportBrutalityPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
SupportBrutalityPlayer.name: Brutality

RapidShotAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with a large clip of heavily modified bolts that cause Heat to build up on your crossbow, before unleashing a stream of flaming bolts that gain Fire Damage based on your Heat. Heat also grants bonus damage to Grenades you fire, but dissipates rapidly when not building up. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
RapidShotAmmoPlayer.name: Load Rapid Shot

SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.
SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.name: Shock Siphon

SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.
SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.name: Supercritical

HeraldOfAshPlayer.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
HeraldOfAshPlayer.name: Herald of Ash

SupportElectrocutePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.
SupportElectrocutePlayer.name: Electrocute

SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.name: Minion Mastery

SupportLastingShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportLastingShockPlayer.name: Lasting Shock

VulnerabilityPlayer.name: Vulnerability
VulnerabilityPlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

SoulrendPlayer.name: Soulrend
SoulrendPlayer.description: Fires a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.

SupportChanceToPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.
SupportChanceToPoisonPlayer.name: Envenom

UnbreakableSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.
UnbreakableSupportPlayer.name: Unbreakable

ArcticArmourPlayer.name: Arctic Armour
ArcticArmourPlayer.description: Conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.

LightningArrowPlayer.description: Fires a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
LightningArrowPlayer.name: Lightning Arrow

ArtilleryBallistaPlayer.description: Deploys a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
ArtilleryBallistaPlayer.name: Artillery Ballista

BoneOfferingPlayer.description:
Impales a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains. The shield absorbs all damage from the next Hit each Minion takes, then explodes.

The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
BoneOfferingPlayer.name: Bone Offering

SupportManaFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.
SupportManaFlaskPlayer.name: Mana Bounty

SupportElementalDischargePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportElementalDischargePlayer.name: Elemental Discharge

GlacialBoltPlayer.description: Fires an icy bolt that creates two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of its flight.
GlacialBoltPlayer.name: Glacial Bolt

IceStrikePlayer.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
IceStrikePlayer.name: Ice Strike

WhirlingAssaultPlayer.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.
WhirlingAssaultPlayer.name: Whirling Assault

TimeOfNeedPlayer.name: Time of Need
TimeOfNeedPlayer.description: Invokes divine blessings, periodically healing you and removing Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.

SupportCulminationPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportCulminationPlayer.name: Culmination

SuperchargedSlamPlayer.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area.
SuperchargedSlamPlayer.name: Supercharged Slam

SupportFasterCastPlayer.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
SupportFasterCastPlayer.name: Arcane Tempo

SupportFocusedCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.
SupportFocusedCursePlayer.name: Focused Curse

SupportCorrosionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.
SupportCorrosionPlayer.name: Corrosion

MetaCastOnCritPlayer.name: Cast on Critical
MetaCastOnCritPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

GaleStrikePlayer.description: Strike enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
GaleStrikePlayer.name: Wind Blast

BleedingConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a bottle that explodes, dealing unarmed Physical attack damage in an area. Bleeding inflicted by this skill has more effect.
BleedingConcoctionPlayer.name: Bleeding Concoction

ContagionPlayer.name: Contagion
ContagionPlayer.description:
Afflicts a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it and all other Chaos damage over time Debuffs spread to nearby enemies and refresh their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to
spread Contagion on hit.

SupportHourglassPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportHourglassPlayer.name: Hourglass

ShieldChargePlayer.name: Shield Charge
ShieldChargePlayer.description: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

ToxicGrowthPlayer.description: Leap into the air and fire a volley of arrows which cause toxic pustules to sprout from the ground on impact. The pustules explode after a delay and can be Poisoned, causing them to explode faster and more violently.
ToxicGrowthPlayer.name: Toxic Growth

FragmentationRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode.
FragmentationRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Fragmentation Rounds

SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.
SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.name: Arcane Surge

SupportWildshardsPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles. Supported Skills have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
SupportWildshardsPlayer.name: Wildshards

SupportChanceToShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.
SupportChanceToShockPlayer.name: Conduction

SupportPinPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.
SupportPinPlayer.name: Pin

SupportFrostfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite.
SupportFrostfirePlayer.name: Frostfire

SupportOverchargePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but last for a shorter duration.
SupportOverchargePlayer.name: Overcharge

TempestFlurryPlayer.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.
TempestFlurryPlayer.name: Tempest Flurry

EncaseInJadePlayer.description: Consumes all stacks of Jade to grant a Buff for a duration that absorbs all Damage from Hits, up to a maximum based on the amount of Jade consumed. While encased you cannot move or perform actions.
EncaseInJadePlayer.name: Encase in Jade

VineArrowPlayer.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.
VineArrowPlayer.name: Vine Arrow

IceBombSkeletonMageMinion.description: Crystallises the air into icy shards that explode outwards when they hit the ground.
IceBombSkeletonMageMinion.name: Ice Bomb

BlinkReservationPlayer.name: Blink
BlinkReservationPlayer.description: Replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

SupportPayloadPlayer.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.
SupportPayloadPlayer.name: Payload

ResonatingShieldPlayer.name: Resonating Shield
ResonatingShieldPlayer.description: Repeatedly strike your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While using Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.description: Summons Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning storm on dead Skeletons on Command.
SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Storm Mage Minion

SupportAdditionalAccuracyPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.
SupportAdditionalAccuracyPlayer.name: Bullseye

MeleeCrossbowPlayer.description: Fires a bolt from your crossbow.
MeleeCrossbowPlayer.name: Crossbow Shot

SupportRicochetPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
SupportRicochetPlayer.name: Ricochet

DemonFormPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.
DemonFormPlayer.name: Demon Form

ElementalConfluxPlayer.name: Elemental Conflux
ElementalConfluxPlayer.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.

SupportTremorsPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.
SupportTremorsPlayer.name: Tremors

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.
SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.name: Searing Flame

SupportManaFlarePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportManaFlarePlayer.name: Mana Flare

SupportExcisePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExcisePlayer.name: Excise

ElementalStormPlayer.description: Creates a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.
ElementalStormPlayer.name: Elemental Storm

DespairPlayer.name: Despair
DespairPlayer.description: Curses all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.

EarthquakePlayer.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
EarthquakePlayer.name: Earthquake

HighVelocityRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that can consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to deal extra damage.
HighVelocityRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load High Velocity Rounds

SupportChillingIcePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.
SupportChillingIcePlayer.name: Frost Nexus

SupportEmpoweredDamagePlayer.description: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to deal more damage.
SupportEmpoweredDamagePlayer.name: Premeditation

SupportComboFinisherPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo, or Triggered Skills.
SupportComboFinisherPlayer.name: Combo Finisher

MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.name: Cast on Minion Death
MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.

SupportCurseEffectPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.
SupportCurseEffectPlayer.name: Heightened Curse

DreadBannerReservationPlayer.name: Dread Banner
DreadBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, killing enemies with Attacks or standing near a Unique enemy generates Valour. Using this Skill consumes its Valour to place an inspiring Banner with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Stun Threshold, Elemental Ailment Threshold and Flask charges while the Banner lasts. The Banner cannot gain Valour while placed, and you cannot place a Banner while you already have a Banner placed.

FreezingShardsPlayer.name: Freezing Shards
FreezingShardsPlayer.description: Launches icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.

SupportDecayingHexPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills. Cursed enemies' bodies decay, taking Chaos damage over time.
SupportDecayingHexPlayer.name: Decaying Hex

OrbOfStormsPlayer.name: Orb of Storms
OrbOfStormsPlayer.description: Creates an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies.

SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.name: Chaos Mastery

FulminatingConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a bottle that explodes, dealing unarmed Lightning attack damage in an area and inflicting Lightning Exposure.
FulminatingConcoctionPlayer.name: Fulminating Concoction

SupportBloodMagicPlayer.description: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportBloodMagicPlayer.name: Lifetap

FrozenLocusPlayer.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal, which creates Chilled Ground around it and can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion that deals Attack damage but does not use your weapon's damage.
FrozenLocusPlayer.name: Frozen Locus

SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.description: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.
SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.name: Perpetual Charge

TempestBellPlayer.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
TempestBellPlayer.name: Tempest Bell

ManaRemnantsPlayer.name: Mana Remnants
ManaRemnantsPlayer.description: Conjures surging lightning to restore your Mana. While active, Shocked enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a Shocked target spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.

PoisonousConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a bottle that explodes, dealing unarmed Chaos attack damage in an area. Poison inflicted by this skill has more effect.
PoisonousConcoctionPlayer.name: Poisonous Concoction

SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.description: Summons Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.name: Skeletal Cleric Minion

InfernalCryPlayer.name: Infernal Cry
InfernalCryPlayer.description: Performs a warcry, Empowering subsequent Attacks. Consumes all Endurance Charges to Empower additional attacks. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death.

SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.name: Infernal Legion

SupportChanceToIgnitePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.
SupportChanceToIgnitePlayer.name: Ignition

SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.
SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.name: Energy Barrier

WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.name: Chaos Bolt
WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.description: Fires a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

SupportRagingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.
SupportRagingCryPlayer.name: Raging Cry

FlameblastPlayer.name: Flameblast
FlameblastPlayer.description: Channels to build destructive energy around you or a targeted Solar Orb. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channelled for.

SupportPracticedComboPlayer.description: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.
SupportPracticedComboPlayer.name: Practiced Combo

PerfectStrikePlayer.description: Charge up your weapon while channelling. Releasing the moment you fully charge will release a wave of Fire.
PerfectStrikePlayer.name: Perfect Strike

SiegeCascadeAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
SiegeCascadeAmmoPlayer.name: Load Siege Cascade

FreezingSalvoPlayer.description: Passively coalesces icy missiles from the air over time. Using the skill fires a missile, firing an additional missile for each that has been accumulated.
FreezingSalvoPlayer.name: Freezing Salvo

DeathStormSkeletonStormMageMinion.description: Lightning bolts strike all fallen Skeletons in the area, creating Shocked Ground around them.
DeathStormSkeletonStormMageMinion.name: Death Storm

IntoTheBreachPlayer.description: Creates a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
IntoTheBreachPlayer.name: Into the Breach

SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.
SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.name: Life Bounty

LightningWarpPlayer.name: Lightning Warp
LightningWarpPlayer.description: Teleports you inside the target's body, causing it to violently explode. Highlights enemies that can be Culled, and can only be used on these enemies or Ball Lightning Projectiles. The target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning Damage to surrounding enemies and creates Shocked Ground.

ColdSnapPlayer.name: Cold Snap
ColdSnapPlayer.description: Shatters the frost on a Frozen enemy, Consuming the Freeze to deal a large amount of Cold Damage to enemies caught in the blast. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to cause it to explode immediately. Any Frozen enemies hit by the Frostbolt's explosion will be dealt Cold Snap's damage and have their Freeze Consumed.

TimeSnapPlayer.description: Manipulates time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.
TimeSnapPlayer.name: Time Snap

BallLightningPlayer.name: Ball Lightning
BallLightningPlayer.description: Fires a slow-moving Projectile that repeatedly shoots bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies.

SupportExtractionPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.
SupportExtractionPlayer.name: Extraction

SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.
SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.name: Fire Penetration

SupportFarCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
SupportFarCombatPlayer.name: Longshot

SupportEncumberancePlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.
SupportEncumberancePlayer.name: Encumbrance

BlasphemyPlayer.name: Blasphemy
BlasphemyPlayer.description: Turns socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

UnboundAvatarPlayer.description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
UnboundAvatarPlayer.name: Unbound Avatar

PlasmaBlastPlayer.description: Channel to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged.
PlasmaBlastPlayer.name: Plasma Blast

MoreDurationSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
MoreDurationSupportPlayer.name: Persistence

SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.
SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.name: Lightning Penetration

SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.description: Summons bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.
SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.name: Skeletal Arsonist Minion

SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.
SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.name: Energy Retention

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to consume Rage to further boost Empowered Attacks.
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.name: Enraged Warcry

SupportGlaciationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.
SupportGlaciationPlayer.name: Glaciation

DisciplinePlayer.name: Discipline
DisciplinePlayer.description: Emits an Aura that grants Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield. The Aura does not affect you.

SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.description: Summons aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command.
SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.name: Skeletal Reaver Minion

MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.name: Barrier Invocation
MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.description: While active, this Invocation gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.name: Double Barrel

SupportMultipleChargesPlayer.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.
SupportMultipleChargesPlayer.name: Profusion

LingeringIllusionPlayer.name: Lingering Illusion
LingeringIllusionPlayer.description: Creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will grant you a Power Charge.

HailstormRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Passively generates bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
HailstormRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Hailstorm Rounds

SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.name: Eternal Flame

SupportIronwoodPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
SupportIronwoodPlayer.name: Ironwood

SupportLastingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.
SupportLastingFrostPlayer.name: Deep Freeze

WitherPlayer.name: Wither
WitherPlayer.description: Channels a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.

BlazingClusterPlayer.name: Ember Fusillade
BlazingClusterPlayer.description: Conjures a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies.

ArcSkeletonMageMinion.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies.
ArcSkeletonMageMinion.name: Arc

IncineratePlayer.name: Incinerate
IncineratePlayer.description: Conjures a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel for, and at maximum strength also apply stacking Fire Exposure and creating Ignited Ground.

IceShardsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location unless the bolt hits an enemy. The ice shards shatter when enemies step on them, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
IceShardsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Ice Shards

SupportDeepCutsPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.
SupportDeepCutsPlayer.name: Deep Cuts

SupportImmolatePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.
SupportImmolatePlayer.name: Immolate

LeapSlamPlayer.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
LeapSlamPlayer.name: Leap Slam

SupportCannibalismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.
SupportCannibalismPlayer.name: Cannibalism

FlickerStrikePlayer.description: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
FlickerStrikePlayer.name: Flicker Strike

ShockGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires.
ShockGrenadePlayer.name: Voltaic Grenade

GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.description: Rains an arrow down from above, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas where it lands. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.name: Gas Arrow

WindDancerPlayer.description: Grants a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by a Melee Attack while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.
WindDancerPlayer.name: Wind Dancer

OverwhelmingPresencePlayer.name: Overwhelming Presence
OverwhelmingPresencePlayer.description: While active, enemies in your Presence are easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.

ElementalExpressionTriggeredPlayer.description: Creates a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
ElementalExpressionTriggeredPlayer.name: Elemental Expression

SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.
SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.name: Armour Explosion

SupportRageforgedPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or trigger yourself, causing it to consume Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to consume, the damage bonus will not apply.
SupportRageforgedPlayer.name: Rageforged

SupportBloodlustPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.
SupportBloodlustPlayer.name: Bloodlust

SupportEnduranceChargeOnArmourBreak.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when it Fully Breaks an enemy's Armour.
SupportEnduranceChargeOnArmourBreak.name: Break Endurance

SupportFieryDeathPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.
SupportFieryDeathPlayer.name: Fiery Death

SupportLeveragePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased chance to Critically Hit against Immobilised Enemies.
SupportLeveragePlayer.name: Leverage

FlameWallPlayer.name: Flame Wall
FlameWallPlayer.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of the character, which Ignites everything within its area.  Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage and inflict the Ignite on hit.

SupportDazingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.
SupportDazingCryPlayer.name: Dazing Cry

PainOfferingPlayer.description:
Impales a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, causing them to use skills more quickly and deal more damage.

The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
PainOfferingPlayer.name: Pain Offering

BoneBlastPlayer.name: Bone Blast
BoneBlastPlayer.description: Conjures a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.

SupportDevastatePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to apply Broken Armour to enemies when causing a Heavy Stun to enemies.
SupportDevastatePlayer.name: Devastate

SupportKnockbackPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.
SupportKnockbackPlayer.name: Bludgeon

GrimFeastPlayer.name: Grim Feast
GrimFeastPlayer.description: Feeds on corpses to bolster your Energy Shield. While active, enemies and Reviving Minions that die in your Presence have a chance to drop Grim Remnants. Picking up a Grim Remnant grants you Energy Shield which can Overflow maximum Energy Shield.

PermafrostBoltsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies.
PermafrostBoltsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Permafrost Bolts

SupportCursedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills no longer have an activation delay, instead creating areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.
SupportCursedGroundPlayer.name: Cursed Ground

SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.
SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.name: Chaos Infusion

SupportGroundEffectDurationPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.
SupportGroundEffectDurationPlayer.name: Despoiler
