ShieldWallPlayer.name: Shield Wall
ShieldWallPlayer.description: Ram your Shield into the ground, throwing up a semi-circular wall of earth. Enemies can attack the walls and your Slams will instantly destroy them. Each wall segment explodes when destroyed, damaging enemies around it.

SupportRageFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create stationary objects. Objects created by supported Skills generate a Font of Rage, creating an Aura which grants Rage over time, as well as preventing Rage loss.
SupportRageFountainPlayer.name: Font of Rage

ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.description: Rapidly fires bolts that Break enemy Armour. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.name: Armour Piercing Rounds

PlagueBurstPlayer.description: Triggered when an enemy Poisoned by a supported skill dies, dealing Physical damage around them based on the built-up Plague.
PlagueBurstPlayer.name: Plague Burst

SupportCapacitorPlayer.description: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.
SupportCapacitorPlayer.name: Capacitor

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.name: Window of Opportunity

SupportFerocityPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Frenzy Charges.
SupportFerocityPlayer.name: Ferocity

ArcPlayer.name: Arc
ArcPlayer.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies.

SupportLifeLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayer.name: Life Thief

SupportHolyDescentPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land
SupportHolyDescentPlayer.name: Holy Descent

SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level.
SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.name: Physical Mastery

HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.description: Fires a powerful Piercing bolt that can consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to deal extra damage.
HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.name: High Velocity Rounds

SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.
SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.name: Danse Macabre

UnearthPlayer.description: Raises spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you.
UnearthPlayer.name: Unearth

SupportAblationPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.
SupportAblationPlayer.name: Ablation

EscapeShotPlayer.description: Leap backwards and fire an arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location you escaped from.
EscapeShotPlayer.name: Escape Shot

LightningBoltPlayer.name: Lightning Bolt
LightningBoltPlayer.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

SupportBeheadPlayer.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.
SupportBeheadPlayer.name: Behead

SupportAncestralUrgencyPlayer.description: Supports Skills which place Totems, causing those skills to place Totems much more quickly.
SupportAncestralUrgencyPlayer.name: Ancestral Urgency

SunderPlayer.description: Slams the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies.
SunderPlayer.name: Sunder

VolcanicFissurePlayer.description: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a fissure will cause an Aftershock, which spreads to all connected fissures.
VolcanicFissurePlayer.name: Volcanic Fissure

SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.description: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.name: Bursting Plague

LivingBombPlayer.name: Living Bomb
LivingBombPlayer.description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy, which grows over a duration. When the duration expires, the seed explodes, damaging the enemy and all other enemies nearby.

SupportIceBitePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses all of your Attacks with Cold damage for a short time.
SupportIceBitePlayer.name: Ice Bite

SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.
SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.name: Withering Touch

SupportElementalFocusPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.
SupportElementalFocusPlayer.name: Elemental Focus

FireboltPlayer.name: Firebolt
FireboltPlayer.description: Launches a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

SupportMomentumPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.
SupportMomentumPlayer.name: Momentum

ScavengedPlatingPlayer.name: Scavenged Plating
ScavengedPlatingPlayer.description: Uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.

WaveOfFrostPlayer.description: Flips backwards and sends forth a Freezing wave in front of you.
WaveOfFrostPlayer.name: Wave of Frost

ExplosiveGrenadePlayer.description: Fires a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
ExplosiveGrenadePlayer.name: Explosive Grenade

SupportCullingStrikePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.
SupportCullingStrikePlayer.name: Culling Strike

AncestralSpiritsPlayer.description: Each of your Totems will summon an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem that summoned the Minion dies then the Ancestral Spirit will too.
AncestralSpiritsPlayer.name: Ancestral Spirits

SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.
SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.name: Life Drain

SolarOrbPlayer.name: Solar Orb
SolarOrbPlayer.description: Creates a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited.

SupportIncreasedArmourBreakPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.
SupportIncreasedArmourBreakPlayer.name: Demolisher

SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.description: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.
SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.name: Murderous Intent

SupportUnleashPlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.
SupportUnleashPlayer.name: Unleash

SupportCooldownReductionPlayer.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover.
SupportCooldownReductionPlayer.name: Ingenuity

CombatFrenzyPlayer.name: Combat Frenzy
CombatFrenzyPlayer.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

HexblastPlayer.name: Hexblast
HexblastPlayer.description: Detonates a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse.

SupportSlowerProjectilesPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
SupportSlowerProjectilesPlayer.name: Deceleration

SupportPotentialPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges.
SupportPotentialPlayer.name: Potential

SupportLightningExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Lightning Exposure when it Shocks an enemy.
SupportLightningExposurePlayer.name: Lightning Exposure

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.name: Inevitable Critical

ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.name: Impact Shockwave

SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.
SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.name: Controlled Destruction

SupportElementalArmyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions.
SupportElementalArmyPlayer.name: Elemental Army

SupportInnervatePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.
SupportInnervatePlayer.name: Innervate

ShieldBlockPlayer.name: Raise Shield
ShieldBlockPlayer.description: Raise your shield to Block all incoming blockable hits. Blocking too much damage while your shield is raised may stagger you.

SupportDazingPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportDazingPlayer.name: Discombobulate

LessDurationSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration shorter.
LessDurationSupportPlayer.name: Fast Forward

SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Slam skills, granting them a chance to create patches of Jagged Ground.
SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.name: Jagged Ground

SupportRagePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
SupportRagePlayer.name: Rage

LightningRodPlayer.description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows release another Lightning burst.
LightningRodPlayer.name: Lightning Rod

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.description: Supports skills which can have a Limited number of effects active at once, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.name: Overabundance

SupportChanceToBleedPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.
SupportChanceToBleedPlayer.name: Lacerate

SupportMeatShieldPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them more life but making them deal less damage.
SupportMeatShieldPlayer.name: Meat Shield

TimeFreezePlayer.description: Releases a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.
TimeFreezePlayer.name: Time Freeze

CorpseCloudPlayer.name: Decompose
CorpseCloudPlayer.description: Consumes a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

SiphoningStrikePlayer.description: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, consumes the Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge.
SiphoningStrikePlayer.name: Siphoning Strike

SupportExecutePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.
SupportExecutePlayer.name: Execute

SupportFireExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Fire Exposure when it Ignites an enemy.
SupportFireExposurePlayer.name: Fire Exposure

EyeOfWinterPlayer.name: Eye of Winter
EyeOfWinterPlayer.description: Fires a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies, plus an extra burst of shards at the end of its flight. If the Eye passes over an Elemental ground surface, it will take on that surface's effect, applying it to nearby enemies and causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.

SupportManaFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create stationary objects. Objects created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana, creating an Aura which grants Mana regeneration.
SupportManaFountainPlayer.name: Font of Mana

SupportLastGaspPlayer.description: Supports skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on for a short duration before dying when they are fatally wounded.
SupportLastGaspPlayer.name: Last Gasp

MalicePlayer.name: Malice
MalicePlayer.description: Emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.

SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.
SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.name: Nimble Reload

SupportMultipleProjectilesPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
SupportMultipleProjectilesPlayer.name: Scattershot

BoneshatterBruteMinion.description: A Strike that causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
BoneshatterBruteMinion.name: Bonebreaker

SupportManaLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.
SupportManaLeechPlayer.name: Soul Thief

SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.
SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.name: Lightning Infusion

ShatteringPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Unarmed Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage. This skill always Strikes with your bare fist, even if you have a Quarterstaff equipped.
ShatteringPalmPlayer.name: Shattering Palm

SupportOverpowerPlayer.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.
SupportOverpowerPlayer.name: Overpower

ProfaneRitualPlayer.name: Profane Ritual
ProfaneRitualPlayer.description: Marks a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.

SupportClarityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportClarityPlayer.name: Clarity

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more damage over time but have a shorter duration.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.name: Swift Affliction

SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.
SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.name: Wind Wave

ViciousHexSupportPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.
ViciousHexSupportPlayer.name: Impending Doom

SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.
SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.name: Neural Overload

LightningConduitPlayer.name: Lightning Conduit
LightningConduitPlayer.description: Calls down lightning to strike all enemies in a cone in front of you. Deals significantly more damage to Shocked enemies but Consumes Shock from them after damaging them. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

SupportSpellEchoPlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay. Cannot support Channelling skills or Remote skills.
SupportSpellEchoPlayer.name: Spell Echo

ShockburstRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Loads your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Using this skill again reloads the clip.
ShockburstRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Shockburst Rounds

EnrageSkeletonReaverMinion.description: Enrage all Skeletal Reavers, causing them to lose life over time and gain Rage on hit. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage.
EnrageSkeletonReaverMinion.name: Enrage

SupportWallFortressPlayer.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.
SupportWallFortressPlayer.name: Fortress

SupportMaimPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.
SupportMaimPlayer.name: Maim

SupportCloseCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
SupportCloseCombatPlayer.name: Close Combat

SupportIciclePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.
SupportIciclePlayer.name: Icicle

SupportChainPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayer.name: Chain

SupportBitingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.
SupportBitingFrostPlayer.name: Biting Frost

SupportPiercePlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.
SupportPiercePlayer.name: Pierce

SupportSecondWindPlayer.description:
Supports skills with cooldowns, giving them extra uses of that cooldown.
Cannot support instant or triggered skills.
SupportSecondWindPlayer.name: Second Wind

SupportMinionPactPlayer.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
SupportMinionPactPlayer.name: Minion Pact

SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.
SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.name: Considered Casting

DarkEffigyPlayer.name: Dark Effigy
DarkEffigyPlayer.description: Raises a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.

RainOfArrowsPlayer.description: Fire arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes your Frenzy Charges to fire more arrows.
RainOfArrowsPlayer.name: Rain of Arrows

StormblastBoltsPlayer.description: Aims skyward and fires charged bolts that land around the target location, dealing damage and lodging in the ground for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause these bolts to explode. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
StormblastBoltsPlayer.name: Stormblast Bolts

IceShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fires icy bolts at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location unless the bolt hits an enemy. The ice shards shatter when enemies step on them, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
IceShardsPlayer.name: Ice Shards
